snippet.title: Demo Trailer ✦ V2.0
snippet.description:
✦ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/45...
✦ Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/V4nD7YfyPh
✦ Follow us on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/...

Draw your spells. Bring your squad. Rule the arena.

The next PAPER STRIKE demo is coming soon. Watch the trailer for a glimpse of what’s waiting for you.

PAPER STRIKE is a fast-paced 3v3 arena game where you become a Warrior Mage and draw runes to cast your spells. Combine magic with instant abilities, coordinate with your teammates, and find the right moment to turn the fight in your favour.

Every spell is a commitment. Every opening is a chance to strike. Whether you’re setting up a play with friends or improvising when everything falls apart, your next move could change the battle.

We’re keeping a few surprises for you to discover in the demo. Until then, join our Discord to meet the community, follow development, and be there when we share the release details.

Want to support PAPER STRIKE? Add the game to your Steam wishlist and follow our Kickstarter page to get notified when the campaign launches. Share this trailer with the friends you want beside you in the arena.

Subscribe for more gameplay, behind-the-scenes previews, and news about the upcoming demo.

#PaperStrike #IndieGame #Trailer #Multiplayer
